title: Supported Cartier boundary: existence
statement: For a scheme T, positive integer N invertible on T, finite commutative ring A with N=0 in A, and effective Cartier closed immersion i:D→T, there exists a unique degree-two Ext class from i_*A_D to the ordinary finite Tate line A_T(1) satisfying SupportedKummerBoundary, the relative torsor-extension normalization of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Ext and its derived realization are as in [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system].

proof.text: Apply the pole-boundary existence and uniqueness and the etale half of the Cartier reduction existence and uniqueness from [lem-sp-cartier-reduction-site-comparison]. Identify SupportedKummerBoundary with CartierEtaleReductionSpec: every witnessing extension has pole class equal to the unique pole boundary; conversely that unique boundary supplies the relative torsor witnesses. Reassociate Yoneda compositions to identify the normalization equations. Transport existence and uniqueness through this equivalence.

theorem supported_cartier_boundary_existsUnique (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))) {D : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) :
    ∃! κ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2, SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA i hI hT κ
